verdict.rationale: Zoom Scribe is a transcription API, and an AI service could plausibly offer natural-language operation, so the axis applies. The evidence only documents programmatic modes (fast, live and batch), API parameters, and a playground for recording or uploading audio. Nothing shows users issuing natural-language commands to operate the product. The llms.txt probe is AI-readable documentation, and its truncated 'MCP C' heading is not evidence of a natural-language control interface.
